text:
Epilepsy clinic letter, 14 March 2026.

I reviewed Mr A in the epilepsy clinic today. His typical pattern is a focal seizure monthly, and that remains the case. He has had seven seizures so far this year. He continues on levetiracetam 500mg twice daily and reports no side effects. MRI brain was normal.
gold_note: The Gan gold convention prefers a stated typical recurring rate over a year-to-date total. A reader who expects the counted total to win will read this letter backwards.

model_first.evidence: He has had seven seizures so far this year
model_first.rationale: The counted total so far this year is the most concrete current frequency statement.

result.evidence: His typical pattern is a focal seizure monthly
result.rationale: The stated typical monthly pattern is the current recurring rate; the year-to-date total is an observation, not the selected current label.

stages.title: Extract
stages.summary: Model returns two frequency events and selects the year-to-date total.
stages.detail: evt_1: typical focal seizure monthly. evt_2: seven seizures so far this year. Model selection: evt_2 → 7 per year.

stages.title: Normalize
stages.summary: Both events become comparable monthly rates.
stages.detail: evt_1 → 1 per month. evt_2 → 7 per year.

stages.title: Select / repair
stages.summary: Named rule typical_over_ytd replaces the model label.
stages.detail: Before: 7 per year. After: 1 per month. Owner: deterministic_rule / seizure_frequency.

stages.title: Evidence
stages.summary: Final evidence must be an exact substring of the letter.
stages.detail: Evidence: His typical pattern is a focal seizure monthly. evidence_exact: true.

stages.title: Project
stages.summary: CLI default output stops at the public result card.
stages.detail: Benchmark category projection is research scoring, not required for local extraction.
